lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏂᎦᎥ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏓᎩᏲᎯᏎᎸ ᎡᏙᏓ, ᎠᎴ ᎥᏝ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏙᏓᏉ ᎤᏩᏒ; ᎥᏝ ᎠᎴ ᎩᎶ ᏯᎦᏔᎭ ᎠᎦᏴᎵᎨᎢ ᎤᏪᏥ ᎤᏩᏒ, ᎩᎶᏃ ᎾᏍᎩ ᏥᎾᏄᎪᏫᏏ ᎡᎳ ᎤᏪᏥ.
lines.english: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.
lines.emitted_text: nika'v kohuhsti takyohihselv etota ale vlha khilo yakhahthaha uwetsi utotakwo uwahsv vlha ale khilo yakhahthaha akayvlike'i uwetsi uwahsv khilono nahski tsinanukowhihsi ela uwetsi

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎡᏤᎾ, ᎠᏴ ᏍᎩᎷᏥ, ᏂᎦᏗᏳ ᎠᎩᎵᏯ ᏗᏥᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᎦᎨᏛ ᏗᏣᎵᏎᎯ, ᎠᏴᏃ ᏓᏨᏯᏪᏐᎸᏍᏔᏂ.
lines.english: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
lines.emitted_text: etsena ayv hskiluhtsi nikatiyu akilhiya tihtsilvwhstanehi ale kaketv titsalhsehi ayvno tatsvyawehsolvhsthani

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎢᏥᏴ ᎠᏆᎩᎳᎾᎶ ᎠᎴ ᏍᎩᏯᏕᎶᏆᏏ, ᎠᏆᏓᏅᏘᏳᏰᏃ ᎠᎴ ᎠᏆᏓᏙᎵᏍᏗᏳ ᎠᎩᎾᏫᏱ, ᏓᏥᏩᏛᎯᏃ ᏗᏣᏓᏅᏙ ᏧᏯᏪᏐᎸᏍᏗᏱ.
lines.english: Take my yoke upon you, and learn of me; for I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
lines.emitted_text: itsiyv akwaklhanalo ale hskiyatelhohkwahsi akwatanthiyuyhenho ale akwatatolihstiyu akinwiyi tatsiwhahthvhino titsatanto tsuyawehsolvhstiyi

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎠᏆᎩᎳᎾᎶᏰᏃ ᏄᎯᏐᏛᎾ, ᎦᎵᏎᎲᏃ ᎤᏓᏌᎧᎯᏳ.
lines.english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
lines.emitted_text: akwaklhanaloyhenho nuhihsohtvna kalihsehvnho utahskhhiyu
